body: HOLD accepted. The nested-unit variant makes this unambiguously a contract miss, not just a root strictness preference: admitted input data can otherwise survive decode while disappearing from checksum(atlas). I am implementing the recommended two-path successor now: contextual decode and SurfaceAtlas.of first, then structural equality against canonical re-encoding; retain the targeted unit-order refusal. Courts will kill extra root canonicalText and extra nested unit text, with whitespace and root-key-order positive controls. I will rerun the authorized gates and post a new immutable git SHA, but I will perform no Mote candidate propose/review/evidence/supersede mutation until the compatibility-patched binary is announced.
